coverage.scope: src/sift + app/backend (unit/API tests; e2e not measured)

defects.description: documented counts are 11,900/5,076/1,024 hunks per language; released data differs
defects.how_found: Data pipeline test vs documented per-language hunk counts
defects.mitigation: Open: documentation discrepancy; reports must quote the released counts, not the documented ones.

defects.description: test split has no TypeScript although val does; TS generalisation is untested
defects.how_found: Data pipeline test of language coverage per split
defects.mitigation: Open: test split has no TypeScript, so TS generalisation is unmeasured; stated as a limitation.

defects.description: plain `diff -u` multi-file output (no `diff --git` lines) merges the second file's header into the previous hunk
defects.how_found: Black-box test on plain `diff -u` multi-file input (no `diff --git` lines)
defects.mitigation: Open: only git-style diffs split files correctly. Mitigation: UI/docs state git unified diff is required.

defects.description: chit-chat filter is exact-match on 8 template phrases; paraphrased pleasantries are kept in the intent
defects.how_found: Black-box error guessing on paraphrased pleasantries in intent turns
defects.mitigation: Open: consolidation is rule-based (8 templates). Mitigation: model still reads the remaining intent; learned filter is future work.

defects.description: comment line copying the intent text added to a misaligned hunk flips 68% (17/25) of detected hunks to 'aligned'; threshold 20%
defects.how_found: Red-team: comment line copying the intent text added to a misaligned hunk
defects.mitigation: Open. Model partly keys on lexical overlap with the intent. Mitigation: strip comment-only added lines before scoring (not implemented) or adversarial training.

defects.description: context comment 'this change implements: <intent>' flips 52% (13/25) of detected hunks to 'aligned'; threshold 20%
defects.how_found: Red-team: context comment claiming 'this change implements: <intent>'
defects.mitigation: Open. Same root cause as D3. Mitigation: ignore comments claiming intent; flag hunks whose only intent-overlap is in comments.
